rationale: The packet establishes the structural layout (Report MGD cells lack the (*1) marker while the 2/Week monitoring frequency bears it; footnote *1 reads 'When discharging'; Outfall 001 is designated Intermittent Flow). However, marker placement alone does not establish whether footnote (*1) governs only the monitoring frequency or also conditions Report MGD discharge-limitation applicability during periods without discharge. The intermittent-flow authorization language could independently condition row requirements, and the packet does not supply NPDES table-convention or reporting guidance needed to close that scope question. Per P5, neither ACCEPT (footnote *1 governs only monitoring) nor REJECT (footnote *1 also conditions Report MGD entries during non-discharge) meets the burden of establishing evidence; the packet itself notes it may be evidence-insufficient.
